knowledge:
- key_parameters: RNA_fragment=Specifies the transcript region to analyze (e.g., "three_prime_utr", "five_prime_utr", or "CDS") ;; format=Set to "BED" in liftOverToExomicBG if the input protein-binding file is a BED file instead of a bedGraph file ;; track_files=In runStereogene, the order must be c(RNA_structure, protein_binding) to avoid inverted data visualization and backward downstream analysis ;; heatmap=Boolean in visualization functions to toggle between heatmap and line plot visualization
- alternatives: Users can input their own RNA structure annotations in BED format (using liftOverToExomicBG) instead of using CapR-derived structures
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing CLIP-seq protein-binding data (either aligned BAM files or peak-called BED intervals) to understand the surrounding RNA secondary structure contexts (stem, hairpin, multibranch, exterior, internal, bulge)
- pitfalls: Failing to set up a new empty directory and using setwd() before running, as some functions generate multiple output files ;; Incorrect order of track_files in runStereogene (must be RNA structure first, then protein binding) which inverts the visualization and downstream analysis ;; runCapR can take hours or days depending on the number of transcripts, fragment length, and maximum base-pairing distance ;; Failing to install and add external software dependencies (bedtools, CapR, StereoGene) to the system PATH

workflows.name: nearbynding_rna_structure_pipeline
workflows.intent: Map and analyze RNA secondary structure contexts proximal to protein-binding sites using CLIP-seq data and CapR/StereoGene.
input: transcript_list.Rda (user's list of transcripts of interest)
protein_binding.bam (aligned CLIP-seq reads) or protein_binding.bed (peak-called intervals)
workflows.stages:
1. Generate a chain file mapping transcript regions end-to-end using GenomeMappingToChainFile
2. Get chromosome sizes for the concatenated transcriptome using getChainChrSize
3. Extract transcriptome sequences using ExtractTranscriptomeSequence
4. Fold RNA sequences using runCapR
5. Convert and clean BAM files to bedGraph using sortBam and CleanBAMtoBG (or skip if using BED)
6. Map protein binding data to the concatenated transcriptome using liftOverToExomicBG
7. Process CapR output and map RNA structures to the transcriptome using processCapRout
8. Calculate cross-correlation between RNA structure and protein binding using runStereogeneOnCapR (or runStereogene for custom tracks)
9. Visualize cross-correlation results using visualizeCapRStereogene or visualizeStereogene
10. Calculate Wasserstein distance between different structural contexts using bindingContextDistance
workflows.code:
GenomeMappingToChainFile(genome_gtf = gtf,
                        out_chain_name = "test.chain",
                        RNA_fragment = "three_prime_utr",
                        transcript_list = transcript_list,
                        alignment = "hg38")

getChainChrSize(chain = "test.chain", 
                out_chr = "chr4and5_3UTR.size")

ExtractTranscriptomeSequence(transcript_list = transcript_list,
                    ref_genome = "Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa",
                    genome_gtf = gtf,
                    RNA_fragment = "three_prime_utr",
                    exome_prefix = "chr4and5_3UTR")

runCapR(in_file = chr4and5_3UTR.fa)

sorted_bam<-sortBam(bam, "chr4and5_sorted")

CleanBAMtoBG(in_bam = sorted_bam)

liftOverToExomicBG(input = "chr4and5_sorted.bedGraph",
                    chain = "test.chain",
                    chrom_size = "chr4and5_3UTR.size",
                    output_bg = "chr4and5_liftOver.bedGraph")

processCapRout(CapR_outfile = system.file("extdata/chr4and5_3UTR.out", 
                                            package="nearBynding"),
                chain = "test.chain",
                output_prefix = "chr4and5_3UTR",
                chrom_size = "chr4and5_3UTR.size",
                genome_gtf = gtf,
                RNA_fragment = "three_prime_utr")

runStereogeneOnCapR(protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver.bedGraph",
                    chrom_size = "chr4and5_3UTR.size",
                    name_config = "chr4and5_3UTR.cfg",
                    input_prefix = "chr4and5_3UTR")

runStereogene(track_files = c("chr4and5_3UTR_stem_liftOver.bedGraph",
                                "chr4and5_liftOver.bedGraph"),
                name_config = "chr4and5_3UTR.cfg")

visualizeCapRStereogene(CapR_prefix = "chr4and5_3UTR",
                        protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver",
                        heatmap = TRUE,
                        out_file = "all_contexts_heatmap",
                        x_lim = c(-500, 500))

visualizeCapRStereogene(CapR_prefix = "chr4and5_3UTR",
                        protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver",
                        x_lim = c(-500, 500),
                        out_file = "all_contexts_line",
                        y_lim = c(-18, 22))

visualizeStereogene(context_file = "chr4and5_3UTR_stem_liftOver",
                    protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver",
                    out_file = "stem_line",
                    x_lim = c(-500, 500))

visualizeStereogene(context_file = "chr4and5_3UTR_stem_liftOver",
                    protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver",
                    heatmap = TRUE,
                    out_file = "stem_heatmap",
                    x_lim = c(-500, 500))

bindingContextDistance(RNA_context = "chr4and5_3UTR_stem_liftOver",
                        protein_file = "chr4and5_liftOver",
                        RNA_context_2 = "chr4and5_3UTR_hairpin_liftOver")
